notes.title: Major update!
notes.content:
Hey zombie killers!

Today I am bringing a huge update containing game progression, improvement, fixes, and news about what is upcoming in the future.

A lot of content was added and since some people were blocked because of the previous mission system, I suggest starting a new session to take full advantage of the content and fixes!

[h1]New content:[/h1]
[list]
[*]2 girls
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771103/556545eac78ac6d91144ab0f4b98717ea079dfff.png[/img]

Each includes a new mission with scenarios and levels. Karina who was a badass before the apocalypse and Anna, who was a sweet nurse. Both of them need your help for different reasons! Help them and bring them to the Bunker!

[*]Crafting System V1
[*]Forge System V1
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771103/853b49bb1ea6aab2e9e300f9bf8471588de85cad.png[/img]

Forge and Crafting Systems are meant to be simple but provide fun in the long term, also give more use to the items in general and it does add a layer to the survival aspect!

[*]Add 40+ items in games
[*]Peaking Shower System V1 (in bunker) (random when you join the girl room)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771103/009040c0da151ffcf90f7a74515c04b449dbfbc2.png[/img]

The first version of the peaking shower! Very simple at the moment but I have good idea to make it a fun exciting mini-game in the future.

[*]Navigation in menu
[*]New Settings UI and Binding System
[*]Bullets can be found and used (instead of being reset every level)
[*]Bullets display in Inventory
[*]Consumable System (bandage + medkit)
[*]Dialogue based on the levels (when the character discover things)
[*]Small animation during Dialogue
[*]Add Spanish and Portuguese Translation (no audio)
[*]New Police Zombie

[/list]
[h1]Fixes & Improvements:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Missions are now deployed in a specific order
[*]Mission Board is now displaying stories more efficiently
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771103/b6487e1f01bbf622f648858883f64cf727ed115d.png[/img]
[*]Missions are easier to complete: if you miss zombies and reach the girl door, instead of having to go back, the zombies will be placed closer to you so you don't have to walk the entire map again
[*]Weapon Loadout has been simplified
[*]Improve loading time for level (Navigation is now static, which prevents unnecessary CPU usage)
[*]Zombies are not twitching when stacking together
[*]Items on the ground are more visible and easy to pick up (no need to directly look at the item)
[*]Tutorial fixes (was blocking the first time)
[*]Loading screen for each level
[*]Stamina feedback when running out
[*]Level lighting/exposure improved
[*]Settings and binding were completely redone which fixed previous input issue and sound issues
[*]Icons for items are realistic instead of white vectorial
[*]Inventory issues with item fixes
[*]Clothes materials improvement
[*]Aiming now correctly to reduce bullet spread
[*]Ressources are spread in the level more evenly (since items were added)
[/list]

Here is what coming next in the coming months! The order is not specific, but if you have a preference, let us know!

[h1]Coming Next:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Grenade/Molotov
[*]Consumable (medicine/enhancing liquid/and more)
[*]New girls, missions, level (20 left to do!)
[*]Small Interaction with Girl in Bunker
[*]Add mini-game for peaking shower
[*]Plants System (to make food)
[*]Living Room with a corridor that gives a door access to each girl instead of a menu
[*]Girl roaming and flirting in living room
[*]Survival System for girls in Bunker (water/food need + special requirement that creates events)
[*]Companion for missions and send on exploration
[*]Companion Rescuing Mission
[*]Day System (for survival aspect with girls, the plant system, and the bunker)
[*]Wave System for protecting Bunker on specific days
[*]Simple Building System
[*]More Items
[*]Improve everything based on you guys feedback!
[/list]

Thank you for reading this huge post! If you like what is happening, don't hesitate to share and like it. See you guys soon for more cool stuff!
